lede: The clearest signal Tuesday is a name resurfacing across two unrelated feeds: Elizabeth Holmes drew 642,791 Wikipedia views and climbed YouTube at the same time, both pulled up by the teaser for 'You Can See Everything,' a Nathan Fielder project. Away from that, the web kept its usual rhythm. Counter-Strike 2 held the top of Steam with 1,226,877 players, and a small GitHub repo, hyperframes, which turns HTML into video for AI agents, gathered 474 stars in a day.

throughlines.gist: A researcher factored the RSA keys of a 1990s certificate authority, a reminder of how much old cryptography is quietly still in play; 210 points and 38 comments on Hacker News.
